title: Console: unit economics dashboard UI (filters, charts, drilldowns) behind internal feature flag
author: Felix Schneider
body:
Summary: Implements the Console UI for the internal unit economics dashboard (blended $/1M output tokens) including top-level filters (model, region, customer tier), core charts, and drilldown navigation. The entire surface is gated behind an internal feature flag so we can dogfood with Finance/Product before wider enablement. This PR intentionally uses “screenshot stubs” (placeholders) pending real data wiring from the dataset + semantic views landing in ENG-2910/PR-11857.

Key UX included (per DES-211):
- Entry point: Console → Analytics → Unit economics (hidden unless feature flag enabled)
- Global filter bar with:
  - Date range (default: Last 14 days)
  - Model (multi-select; default: All)
  - Region (multi-select; default: All)
  - Customer tier (single-select; default: All; tier labels: self_serve / dedicated / private / enterprise)
- Primary charts:
  - Blended cost trend (line): $/1M output tokens over time, with tooltip breakdown and comparison to previous period
  - Cost by driver (stacked bar, v0): compute vs overhead vs “cache savings” (note: savings shown as separate series, not netted in the bar until we finalize semantics)
  - Mix breakdown table: top models and regions by output tokens and blended cost contribution
- Drilldowns:
  - Clicking a point in the trend chart opens a right-side panel with a per-day breakdown table
  - Clicking a model/region row navigates to a slice-specific URL with query params preserved (shareable)
  - Drilldown table supports pagination and a hard limit to avoid high-cardinality queries (see notes below)

Feature flag:
- Flag key: console.unit_econ_dashboard (internal-only)
- Behavior:
  - When off: route returns 404 and nav item is hidden
  - When on: route is available and nav item appears under Analytics

Guardrails / performance notes:
- Filter selections are normalized and persisted to URL query params (so “copy link” works reliably).
- Added UI-side query debouncing (300ms) and request cancellation to avoid spamming the backend as filters change.
- Added client-side caps for multi-selects (max 10 models, max 10 regions) with an inline warning. This mirrors the backend guardrails we’re adding in ENG-2919, but keeps the UI safe during dogfood.
- Empty/loading/error states:
  - Loading skeletons for each card
  - “Data freshness” banner is currently a stub (will be wired to dataset health endpoint from ENG-2917)
  - Reconciliation variance banner is not included here (DES-212 follow-up)

Screenshots (stubs):
- Dashboard landing (filters + trend): /docs/screenshots/unit-econ/dashboard_landing.png (placeholder)
- Drilldown panel open: /docs/screenshots/unit-econ/drilldown_panel.png (placeholder)
- Empty state: /docs/screenshots/unit-econ/empty_state.png (placeholder)

Files / areas changed (high-level):
- console/web/src/routes/analytics/unit-economics/* (new route + layout)
- console/web/src/components/unitEcon/* (cards, charts, tables)
- console/web/src/lib/featureFlags.ts (flag gate)
- console/web/src/lib/queryState.ts (URL state helpers)
- console/web/src/api/unitEconClient.ts (typed client + cancellation)
- console/web/src/styles/* (minor)

Testing:
- Unit tests for query param serialization and filter normalization
- Storybook stories for the cards with mocked datasets
- Manual:
  - Flag off: nav hidden and direct route 404
  - Flag on: dashboard loads with mocked fixtures and preserves filters in URL

Rollout plan:
- Merge behind console.unit_econ_dashboard
- Enable for internal Finance/Product dogfood cohort after ENG-2915 endpoint is stable
- Collect feedback in #eng-platform and #product-console

Follow-ups (not included):
- Explain cost delta panel (DES-212)
- Data freshness + reconciliation banners wired to real health endpoints (ENG-2917/ENG-2914)
- Export CSV button and saved views (product request; likely V2)

Related:
- ENG-2916 (this PR)
- DES-211 (layout/filter UX)
- PM-482 (epic)

Notes for reviewers:
- Chart data adapters are intentionally thin and currently accept both “old” and “new” column names to unblock UI review while semantic views finalize. Once PR-11857 is merged everywhere, I’ll remove the legacy mappings.
- The “cache savings” series is displayed but not netted into blended cost until Finance signs off on semantics (see PM-483/ADR-0142).

5) console(unit-econ): add request cancellation + debounced refetch

7) chore(storybook): unit econ stories and screenshot stubs

review_conversation:
Marissa Cole (Product) — 2025-02-06: The filter UX matches the mock pretty well. Two questions: (1) can we default tier to All but show the tier filter only when the user has permissions? (2) Can the trend chart include a “previous period” overlay toggle?
Felix Schneider — 2025-02-06: (1) Yep — I gated the tier filter rendering behind the same entitlement we use for other finance-sensitive analytics. If the user lacks it, tier is forced to All and the UI hides the control. (2) Added a lightweight compare toggle; default is on for now per your note.

Logan Wright (Eng, Telemetry/Analytics) — 2025-02-07: Please cap the model/region multi-selects. We saw some pathological requests in the prototype when someone selected 40+ models. Also: can you ensure we cancel in-flight requests when filters change?
Felix Schneider — 2025-02-07: Added a max of 10 per multi-select with warning + cancel token support in the client. Also debounced refetch.

Aisha Bello (SRE/Observability) — 2025-02-08: The error state is fine, but we should surface “data is stale” separately from “backend error.” Even if it’s a stub, can you put the component in place so we can wire it later?
Felix Schneider — 2025-02-08: Added a banner component with a TODO to wire to the dataset health endpoint once ENG-2917 lands; currently controlled by a mocked field in fixtures.

Thomas Baird (Perf/Cardinality) — 2025-02-09: For the drilldown table: please avoid client-side sorting on large pages; keep it server-driven only, or disable sorting in v0.
Felix Schneider — 2025-02-09: Disabled client-side sorting for now; we can re-enable once the backend supports stable ordering and indexes.

Alicia Perez (Design) — 2025-02-09: Minor: spacing on the filter bar chips is a bit tight in narrow widths. Also the empty state should include a link to “clear filters.”
Felix Schneider — 2025-02-10: Tweaked responsive spacing and added a clear-filters link + button.

Approvals:
- Marissa Cole — Approved (2025-02-10)

- Aisha Bello — Approved (2025-02-10)
